main_text.p: bat in austrum: sit ut umbræ Meridianæ alias nullæ sint, alias in Meridiem uel Septentrionem procidant.
[Woodcut diagram: a hemisphere with letters G, B, K, C, A, F, D, H and numerals 1–12 along the arcs.]

p.i: EXTRA Æquatorem sub quouis Parallelo dies annuatim bis adæquantur noctibus, æstiui dies producuntur, noctes deficiunt, hybernæ noctes contra extenduntur, dies minuuntur: quædam stellæ exaltatæ cum polo boreo perpetuo eminent, quædam cum arctico depressæ & abditæ latent, Reliquæ oriuntur & occidunt, tantoq; uarietas hæc maior & euidentior fit, quanto loca longius ab æquatore disident.

page.notes: Woodcut diagram not transcribed as text; the catchword "Tertium" is set at the right below the paragraph and is given once. Page number and running head absent. Scan shows a watermark-style URL at bottom (http://rcin.org.pl), which is a digitiser's link and omitted.
